title: VirSME AI | Business-Rule-Aware AI for End-to-End Workflows
description: AI that understands business data, SOPs, processes, policies, permissions and authority structures to help execute authorised workflows end to end.
hero: AI that understands how your business is supposed to operate.
intro: Most business AI understands the information it can access. VirSME AI is designed to go further by combining authorised business context with SOPs, processes, policies, controls and authority structures.

blocks.text: The objective is not merely to summarise information or draft text. It is to understand what should happen next and help execute the authorised workflow across VirSME modules.
Minimal intervention. Human authorization where it matters.
Repeatable work can move automatically when rules are clear and permissions allow it. Judgement, exceptions, approvals and high-impact actions are routed to the authorised person.

A hiring decision can trigger the approved onboarding process, employee record, required documents, access rules, training, work assignments, notifications and approval points across the relevant modules.
VirSME AI can identify the customer context, determine the applicable process, prepare the required actions or response, and route anything requiring authorization before completion.
AI that knows what to do next because it understands how your business operates.
